question: For what duration must the practice be carried out in order for old age and death to be destroyed?
premises: The practice is carried out for one year.
When that practice has been performed for one year, a result follows.
The result is that old age and death are destroyed.
inference: When the practice has been carried out for one year, old age and death are destroyed.
uncertainties: Nature of the practice not specified in this verse
plain_english: When practiced for one year, old age and death are destroyed.
